issues.problem: tr-aku explain: 開く read ひらく described as a verb that takes を; ひらく is also intransitive (花が開く, ドアが開く).
issues.action: Rewrote: ひらく works both ways, with 本を開く / 花が開く.

issues.problem: tr-aku contrast ひらく: same overstatement that ひらく takes を.
issues.action: Rewrote: ひらく is both transitive (本を開く) and intransitive (花が開く).

issues.problem: tr-aku explain: 'Requests, offers and invitations are always the transitive' overstated and 'invitations' does not fit.
issues.action: Changed to: requests and offers are about doing it, so they take the transitive.

issues.problem: tr-kowareru explain: claimed all five -reru intransitives 'drop it' in the transitive; false for 壊れる/壊す and 汚れる/汚す (-su).
issues.action: Split the shape rule: 割る/切る/折る drop -re-; 壊す/汚す end in -su.

issues.problem: tr-hairu explain: '財布を落とした ... even by accident' is confusing (dropping is accidental by nature).
issues.action: Reworded: 落とす is the normal verb for losing something you dropped without noticing.
